chapter_notes: A review chapter with no quantitative pharmacology: no IC50, Ki, EC50, dose or pharmacokinetic values are given for any compound. Not recorded because they are not compound-on-target mechanisms: the endocannabinoid synthesis and degradation enzymes (NAT, PLD, PLC, DAGL, FAAH, MAGL; Fig. 2), the downstream signalling of CB1R activation (inhibition of voltage-dependent calcium channels and adenylate cyclase, activation of inwardly rectifying potassium channels; Figs. 3 and 4), knock-out mice (Table 1), and pentobarbital, pancuronium, isoflurane and BrdU, which are named without a molecular target. Compounds named only in reference-list titles (PDF pages 127-134) were not extracted.
